title: Blanton versus Mingus and Ben Webster showing him off
summary: Mingus said only Blanton beat him; Duke kept Blanton; Ben Webster took him out.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Bass players: lineage, tone and technique

blocks.x: In fact, Mingus said -- I talked to a guy this morning that had worked with Mingus for a while --
Mingus was with us a while.
Mingus said the only bass player he couldn't cut was Blanton. He said none of the others mean nothing to him, as far as a challenge. But just after he had heard Blanton play --

Jimmy'd eat him up, man. I'd play with both of them, Charlie and Jimmy. Eat them up, without any sweat. He was -- man, I don't know. He was so great. And when he was with us everybody tried to lure him. No chance. He's something else.
Oh, a lot of guys were trying to steal him from the band?

Yeah. But Duke laid so much bread on him, not a chance. Then he loved everybody in the band. Especially Ben Webster, he loved Ben Webster. Ben would take him everywhere and show him off to people. Of course, Benny always had somewhere to go, you know, different sections, different clubs. And he'd sic Jimmy on them. Jimmy wasn't wild like me and Ben, me and Frog, (that was his nickname.) But
